subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Fourth graders read history, science, and technical texts and understand them, using all their skills: main idea and details, text structure, vocabulary, and evidence. Good readers reread, use text features, and connect ideas to make sense of harder texts.

items.prompt:
Read.

The rainforest has layers. The top is the canopy, where most animals live. Below is the shady understory, and at the bottom is the dark forest floor.

What is the main idea?

steps: I ask what the whole text is about.
It explains the layers of the rainforest.
So the main idea is that the rainforest has different layers.

items.prompt:
Read (same text).

Where do most animals live?

steps: I find the detail about animals.
So most animals live in the canopy.

items.prompt:
Read.

Thomas Edison failed thousands of times before inventing a working light bulb. He said each failure taught him what would not work.

What can you conclude about Edison?

steps: He failed many times but did not give up and learned from it.
So Edison was persistent and learned from failure.
solution.answer: He was persistent and learned from failure.

items.prompt:
Read.

The water cycle moves water from the ocean to the sky and back as rain.

Main idea?

steps: The water cycle / how water moves.

items.prompt:
Read.

Penguins huddle together to stay warm in the cold.

Why do penguins huddle?
